name: footer-privilege
title: Footer Privilege
blurb: Premium footer with light typography, branded icon lockup, and dark/light theme…
description: A sophisticated footer featuring asymmetrical layout with large heading, SVG-based logo lockup, descriptive tagline, contact CTA button, and copyright bar. Fully theme-aware with smooth color transitions.
use_when: Premium SaaS, luxury brands, or product sites wanting an elevated footer presence.
avoid_when: Space-constrained layouts; the component uses generous padding and large typography.
a11y: Semantic `<footer>` element. All interactive elements (button, links) are keyboard accessible. Link has `target='_blank'` with proper labeling.
